entities.summary: The Keikyū Kurihama Line  is a 13.4-kilometre (8.3 mi) private railway line operated by Keikyū in Japan. Keikyu Main Line trains from Oshiage and Shinagawa in Tokyo connect to the Miura Peninsula on the Keikyū Kurihama Line.
